# TikTok

> > TikTok is a global short-form video platform offering creator tools, e-commerce through TikTok Shop, AR effects via Effect House, and advertising solutions, with a focus on community safety and data protection.

TikTok provides resources for content creators, businesses, and users including mobile apps for Android and iOS, safety guidelines, career opportunities, and tools for creating AR effects. The platform emphasizes community standards, user data protection through partnerships with Oracle Cloud, and supports diverse creator communities.

## Key Topics

- TikTok
- Effect House
- Community Guidelines
- TikTok Shop
- TikTok for Good
- Content creators
- AR effects and filters
- Age verification
- App download (Android/iOS)
- Creator spotlight
- Women creators
- Campus recruiting
- Ad measurement and analytics
- User data protection
- Video creation and transitions

## Getting Started

- [About | TikTok](https://tiktok.com/about): TikTok mission, global offices, and community-driven platform overview
- [Download the TikTok app for Android and iOS - Get official latest version](https://tiktok.com/download/en): Official TikTok app download page for Android and iOS with QR code option
- [New user guide](https://tiktok.com/safety/en/new-user-guide): Getting started guide covering account setup, safety tools, and privacy
- [Helpful links](https://support.tiktok.com/en/help): TikTok support hub with account creation and profile setup resources

## Creator Tools & Resources

- [Create TikTok effects | TikTok effect house](https://effecthouse.tiktok.com): Effect House platform for creating AR filters and TikTok visual effects
- [Introduction to Effect House | Learn | TikTok Effect House](https://effecthouse.tiktok.com/learn/guides/getting-started/introduction-to-effect-house): Effect House beginner guide for creating AR effects and filters
- [Creating videos](https://support.tiktok.com/en/using-tiktok): TikTok help documentation for video creation and platform usage
- [How To Film TikTok Transitions: Guide To Shooting Videos | TikTok For Business Blog](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en-US/blog/behind-the-camera-shooting-tips-and-transitions-to-make-your-tiktoks): Business guide for shooting TikTok videos with transitions and techniques

## Safety & Community

- [Guardian's Guide](https://tiktok.com/safety/en/guardians-guide): Parent guide for TikTok safety, teen controls, and Community Guidelines
- [Facts Matter: How TikTok Protects U.S. User Data - Newsroom | TikTok](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/facts-matter-how-tiktok-protects-us-user-data): TikTok U.S. Data Security Inc. and Oracle Cloud data protection measures
- [The Truth About TikTok: Separating Fact from Fiction. - Newsroom | TikTok](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/the-truth-about-tiktok): Fact-checking article on ByteDance ownership and corporate governance myths

## Business & Advertising

- [TikTok Shop: Free Shipping on Clothing, Beauty & More](https://shop.tiktok.com/us): TikTok Shop ecommerce marketplace with flash sales and premium offers
- [Ad Campaign Measurement and Performance Solutions | TikTok for Business](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en-US/products/measurement): TikTok ad measurement tools including Attribution Analytics and Lift Studies
- [TikTok Spotlight: A new way to tap into the entertainment community - Newsroom | TikTok](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/tiktok-spotlight): TikTok Spotlight promotional solution for movie and TV marketing

## Careers

- [We Are TikTok](https://careers.tiktok.com): TikTok careers homepage highlighting ByteStyle values and company culture
- [Early Careers](https://careers.tiktok.com/campus): TikTok campus recruiting for internships and early career opportunities

## News & Community Stories
